requirements.zh: 需兼容的 Agent、此技能与图像生成工具。生成消耗所用服务的额度或费用，请先确认预算；图像输出不是可编辑矢量源文件。

output.en: An author-published visual style example. The suggested task is our adaptation, not the original prompt.
output.zh: 作者公开的视觉风格示例。建议任务为本站整理，不是原始提示词。

output.en: One raster slide style preview, not a complete deck or a natively editable PPTX.
output.zh: 一张栅格幻灯片风格示例，不是完整文稿或原生可编辑 PPTX。

input.en: Your presentation outline, audience, verified figures and licensed images.
input.zh: 演示大纲、受众、已核实数字和获准使用的图片。

requirements.en: Frontend Slides, a coding agent with filesystem access and a browser. Use its bold-template pack; images and fonts may need your own licensed replacements.
requirements.zh: 需 Frontend Slides、可访问文件的编程 Agent 和浏览器；使用其 bold-template pack，图片与字体可能需要替换为有权使用的素材。

output.en: Selected views of one HTML template supported by Frontend Slides. Multiple screenshots count as one example. Not a completed customer project or editable PPTX.
output.zh: Frontend Slides 支持的一套 HTML 模板的精选视图。多张截图只计一个案例，不是客户项目或可编辑 PPTX。

input.en: Your product brief, real copy, brand assets and desired file format.
input.zh: 产品需求、真实文案、品牌素材与期望文件格式。

requirements.en: Huashu Design with its complete references, assets and scripts, a compatible coding agent and a browser. Confirm any paid generation tools before use.
requirements.zh: 需完整安装 Huashu Design 的参考资料、素材和脚本，配合兼容编程 Agent 与浏览器；使用收费生成工具前先确认。

output.en: An author-published design screenshot. Backend behavior and editable exports are not verified here. Example numbers are not current benchmark evidence.
output.zh: 作者公开的设计截图。此处不验证后端功能或可编辑文件导出；示例数字不是当前基准测试证据。

input.en: A concrete brief, content, sample data and output requirements.
input.zh: 具体需求、内容、示例数据和交付要求。

requirements.en: Install Open Design locally and connect a coding agent. This is an application workflow composing skills; external AI media services may charge separately.
requirements.zh: 需本地安装 Open Design 并连接编程 Agent。这是组合技能的应用工作流；外部 AI 媒体服务可能单独收费。

output.en: An author-published design preview. A screenshot does not verify backend functions, email delivery, data connections or animation playback.
output.zh: 作者公开的设计预览。截图不验证后端功能、邮件发送、数据连接或动画播放。

input.en: An original short script, aspect ratio, approved brand assets and verified data where applicable.
input.zh: 简短原创脚本、画幅、获准使用的品牌素材，以及需要时提供的已核实数据。

requirements.en: Open Design, the corresponding video-template plugin and its HTML-video/HyperFrames renderer. Confirm renderer setup and licensed brand replacements before export.
requirements.zh: 需 Open Design、对应视频模板插件及 HTML-video/HyperFrames 渲染环境。导出前确认配置，并替换为获准使用的品牌素材。

output.en: The author’s playable MP4 template preview plus its still frame. A reusable motion composition, not a new platform-produced campaign.
output.zh: 作者可播放的 MP4 模板预览及静帧。这是可复用动态模板，不是本站新制作的营销项目。
